outputs.justification: ProteomeXchange / ProteomeCentral lists dataset PXD069095 with title matching the manuscript and shows it is hosted in PRIDE, including an FTP archive path for PXD069095; this indicates the PRIDE project record and data archive are available. (ProteomeCentral record). ([proteomecentral.proteomexchange.org](https://proteomecentral.proteomexchange.org/cgi/GetDataset?ID=PXD069095-1&test=no))

Attempts to open the URL returned a 502 Bad Gateway / failed to fetch in the automated check, so the site was not reachable at the time of verification. External catalogues (DatabaseCommons / cached snapshots) indicate the database exists at this address, but the live URL did not resolve in this check. Recommend the authors ensure the rnagranuledb server is up or provide an alternative stable DOI/hosted record. ([]())

The UniProt website (authors cite UniProt as the source of GO/sequence annotations) is a public data repository and the homepage is reachable (note: site requires JavaScript for full UI). Authors referenced UniProt retrieval on April 16, 2023. ([uniprot.org](https://www.uniprot.org/))
